title: Delete Your Subscriptions: 4 Free GitHub Tools
description:
Before paying for another software subscription, check GitHub.
Four free, open-source projects worth knowing:

LocalSend: private, cross-platform file sharing
https://github.com/localsend/localsend

Immich: self-hosted photo and video management
https://github.com/immich-app/immich

AppFlowy: a privacy-focused alternative to Notion
https://github.com/AppFlowy-IO/AppFlowy

OpenColorIO: professional colour management for film, VFX and animation
https://github.com/AcademySoftwareFoundation/OpenColorIO
Which one should I test in a full video?

#GitHub #OpenSource #FreeSoftware #VibeCoding #Codex #CreativeTechnology #Shorts

Stop overpaying for software! 💸 Here are the links to the repos mentioned in this video:
